title: 第2576章 二次异变的地幽光第2575章 又见大钱
content_zh:
，，！
二次异变的地幽光（二次异变的地幽光（第22页）地脉深处有一股奇异的波动正在上涌，像有什么东西从地底深处浮了上来。
那波动带着一股极浓郁而纯粹的幽力气息，比之前地脉中任何一次共鸣都要强烈。
两人同时朝着波动传来的方向走过去。
走了大约二十步，在长廊的一处拐角，地脉的岩壁上忽然裂开了一道细缝，一朵奇异的金色花朵从缝隙中探出来。
那花只有拳头大小，花瓣层层叠叠，像是用最细的金线编织而成的，不像是真实的花朵。
花蕊中央，密密麻麻地排列着数百颗花粉颗粒，每一颗都有半个米粒那么大，饱满圆润，在金光中像一粒粒凝固的琥珀。
卢潜跟在两人身后，看到那朵花之后，他的声音颤抖起来：“金髓幽花！”
紧接着卢潜催促：“快快收集花粉！”
张楚心念一动，金髓幽花的花粉？那“入门功法”
之中有过记载。
其中，第四次幽觉所需要的几味主药，其中之一就是这种花粉。
只有这种花粉不够，除此之外，还需要另外两种主药，至于辅药，范围倒是可以放宽许多，有多种药材可以相互替换。
张楚蹲下身，仔细看了看那些花粉颗粒。
每一颗都散发着温润的光泽，用手轻轻碰了一下，指尖传来一股温热的幽力波动，浑身的幽力都跟着微微颤了一下。
张楚立刻取出玉瓶，小心的把这些花粉收入玉瓶之中。
张楚把金髓幽花的花粉收集好之后，那花朵竟然自己消失了，整条长廊空间一下子暗淡下来。
他仔细感受了一下，发现周围的幽力正在退却，像是被抽走了一样。
他扭头问卢潜：“怎么回事？”
卢潜回答道：“每一条地脉可孕育的幽果或者神秘物质都是有限的。”

“咱们如今所在的这处地脉，是一条很细小的支脉，那朵花盛开之后，地脉力量就耗尽了，幽力自然渐渐平息下去。”
张楚心中恍然。
卢潜为了活命，不可能直接带他们去最大的地脉，他要一点点吊着张楚，一方面让张楚可以得到造化，另一方面，也要持续保住他自己的价值。
张楚想了想，这才说道：“我们还需要几味主药才能进入四次幽觉，你再带我们去找找吧。”
content_en:
,,!
The Second Mutation of Earthly Gloom (Second Mutation of Earthly Gloom (page 22)) There is a strange wave rising deep in the earth's veins, as if something is rising from the depths of the ground.
The fluctuation carried an extremely rich and pure aura of ghost power, which was stronger than any resonance in the earth's veins before.
The two of them walked towards the direction of the wave at the same time.
After walking about twenty steps, at a corner of the corridor, a thin crack suddenly opened in the rock wall of the leyline, and a strange golden flower poked out from the crack.
The flower was only about the size of a fist, and its petals were layered in layers, as if they were woven with the finest gold threads. They didn't look like real flowers.
In the center of the flower, hundreds of pollen grains are densely arranged, each one is as big as half a grain of rice, plump and round, and looks like grains of solidified amber in the golden light.
Lu Qian followed the two of them. After seeing the flower, his voice trembled: "Golden Marrow Flower!"
Then Lu Qian urged: "Collect pollen quickly!"
Zhang Chu thought, the pollen of the golden marrow flower? That "beginner's technique"
There are records in it.
Among them, one of the main ingredients needed for the fourth trance is this pollen.
This kind of pollen alone is not enough. In addition, two other main drugs are needed. As for the auxiliary drugs, the scope can be broadened a lot, and there are many kinds of medicinal materials that can be replaced with each other.
Zhang Chu squatted down and looked carefully at the pollen particles.
Each one exudes a warm luster. When you touch it lightly with your hand, a warm wave of ghost energy comes from your fingertips, and the whole body of ghost energy trembles slightly.
Zhang Chu immediately took out the jade bottle and carefully put the pollen into the jade bottle.
After Zhang Chu collected the pollen from the Golden Marrow Flower, the flower disappeared on its own, and the entire corridor suddenly dimmed.
He felt it carefully and found that the surrounding force was receding, as if it had been drawn away.
He turned to Lu Qian and asked, "What's going on?"
Lu Qian replied: "The number of ghost fruits or mysterious substances that each earth vein can breed is limited."
"The earth vein where we are now is a very small branch. After the flower blooms, the power of the earth vein is exhausted, and the mysterious power naturally gradually subsides."
Zhang Chu suddenly felt at ease.
In order to survive, Lu Qian could not take them directly to the largest earth line. He had to hang on to Zhang Chu little by little. On the one hand, Zhang Chu could get good fortune, and on the other hand, he had to continue to maintain his own value.
Zhang Chu thought for a while and then said: "We still need a few main ingredients to enter the fourth trance. You can lead us to find them."
